products.title: The Building Blocks 2024
products.body_html:
Medium-bodied, bright red and black fruits, herbal overlay, vibrant acidity, very fresh yet structured, clear fruit with tension and drive. Tannins are firm and tightly packed, leading to a dry finish.

Grapes: 53% Grenache, 35% Pinot Noir, 12–15% Mourvèdre (different sources list slightly varying proportions, but around 15% for Mourvèdre)

Alcoholpercentage: 13,5%

Vinification: Native, 50% whole bunch, 16 days skin contact, 22 months neutral French oak, no fining/filter, minimal sulfur.

Appareance: Red blend with youthful energy.

Nose & Palate: Black cherries, spiced jam, musk, herbs, thyme.

products.title: Paying The School Fees 2024
products.body_html:
Grapes:

39% Sauvignon Blanc, 23% Chardonnay, 23% Grenache Blanc, 15% Chenin Blanc

Alcoholpercentage: 12,5%

Vinification:

  • Hand‑harvested from 4‑year‑old vines in Platteklip Vineyard at ~650–785 m altitude, planted in Table Mountain sandstone soils.

  • Grapes selected at different ripeness levels to manage pH and acidity. 

  • Cold‑soaked on skins for 2 days (~48 h) before pressing. 

  • Spontaneous (native yeast) fermentation in old neutral oak barrels.

  • Matured on gross lees for 22–23 months (“two winters”) in neutral French oak barrels.

  • Bottled unfined, unfiltered, with minimal sulfur (≈33 ppm total SO₂). 

Appareance: Pale, shimmering yellow (golden hues) with youthful energy and complexity.

Nose & Palate: Aromatic complexity: citrus, peach, potpourri, herbs, waxy and leesy notes, salted‑dough hints, fynbos flowers and herbal spice. Balanced energy and structure—thrilling tension despite youthful vines.

products.title: Holderbaum Riesling 2024 MAGNUM
products.body_html:
A refined and elegant Riesling showcasing vibrant freshness, delicate fruitiness, and a pronounced minerality. This wine embodies balance and sophistication, making it an excellent choice for a variety of occasions.

Grapes: 100% Riesling
Alcohol: 13%

products.title: Scarabee Cantillon x Geschickt Kaefferkopf
products.body_html:
Scarabée Cantillon x Geschickt Kaefferkopf is a unique collaboration blending Cantillon lambic with Gewürztraminer grape pomace from the renowned Kaefferkopf vineyard in Alsace.
Elegant and dry, it combines notes of white grapes, lychee, flowers, citrus and earthy wild fermentation character.
A refined, wine-like lambic with Cantillon’s signature funk, bright acidity and exceptional complexity.

products.title: Lieu-Dit Neutal Pinot Blanc 2024
products.body_html:
The Lieu-Dit Im Schloss Riesling 2022 by Domaine Geschickt is a vibrant, expressive wine made from grapes grown on clay-limestone soils, which enhance its minerality and acidity. The wine is naturally fermented with indigenous yeasts and without added sulfites, allowing the pure flavors of the terroir to shine.

Grapes: 100% Riesling

products.title: Lieu-Dit Im Schloss Riesling 2024
products.body_html:
The Lieu-Dit Im Schloss Riesling 2022 by Domaine Geschickt is a vibrant, expressive wine made from grapes grown on clay-limestone soils, which enhance its minerality and acidity. The wine is naturally fermented with indigenous yeasts and without added sulfites, allowing the pure flavors of the terroir to shine.

Grapes: 100% Riesling

products.title: 6 Pieds Sur Terre 2024
products.body_html:
Domaine Geschickt has been farming biodynamically since 1998, with Aurelie Fayolle and Arnaud Geschickt leading the charge for the past decade. Situated across 4 hectares in Ammerschwihr, this family-run domaine works harmoniously with the environment, including planting trees to enhance biodiversity and tending the land with their mare, Iris.

6 Pieds sur Terre is a captivating field blend of Riesling, Muscat, Gewürztraminer, Pinot Blanc, Pinot Gris, and Pinot Noir, grown on clay soils. The grapes are co-macerated with spontaneous fermentation and aged for 24 months in barrels, resulting in a wine that is fresh and elegant with citrus notes, floral aromatics, white stone fruits, and a mineral backbone. Perfectly suited to pair with dishes like roast nectarine and endive salad.

Origin: Alsace, France
Grapes: Riesling, Muscat, Gewürztraminer, Pinot Blanc, Pinot Gris, Pinot Noir
Style: Fresh, citrus, floral, mineral-driven
Year: 2023
Vinification: Co-macerated with spontaneous fermentation and aged for 24 months in barrels
Pairing: Roast nectarine and endive salad or other fresh, lightly savory dishes.

products.title: Rosa Sekt - 2024
products.body_html:
The Crémant de Pinot by Lukas Krauß is a premium sparkling wine from the Pfalz, made with Souvignier Gris and a little Blaufrankisch. Crafted using the traditional method and aged on lees, it has fine bubbles and flavors of red and black berries, with a crispy finish. It pairs well with many dishes, reflecting Lukas Krauß’s authentic winemaking style.

Grapes: Souvignier Gris and a little Blaufrankisch 

Alcoholpercentage: 12,5%

Profile: Green apple, citrus zest, and subtle brioche notes.

products.title: The Orange Pouch
products.body_html:
A juicy and refreshing orange wine crafted from Grüner Veltliner, Welschriesling, and Traminer. Bursting with tropical notes of lychee and pineapple, it’s balanced by flavors of apricot and orange on the palate. Perfect for any occasion, this wine is served in convenient and sustainable pouches, with each pouch equaling two bottles of wine.

Grapes: Grüner Veltliner 60%, Welschriesling 35%, Traminer 5%
Size: 1500ml (1 pouch = 2 bottles)
Alcohol: 11.5%

products.title: Ourem Red 2022
products.body_html:
A lively, organically crafted red wine from the Lisboa region. Made using traditional winemaking methods, it blends red and white grapes, including Trincadeira and Fernão Pires, from ancient, low-yielding vines. With aromas of orange citrus, lavender, and dried herbs, it offers a rich palate of blackberry, plum, cinnamon, and dried fig, with hints of violets and tobacco. At 13.5% ABV, it’s a beautifully balanced wine that highlights Portugal’s winemaking heritage and the preservation of historic vineyards.

Grapes: Trincadeira and Fernão Pires.
Profile: Rich, complex, blackberry, plum, violets, tobacco.
Alcoholpercentage: 13,5%

products.body_html:

products.title: Cremant de Pinot - 2024
products.body_html:
The Crémant de Pinot by Lukas Krauß is a premium sparkling wine from the Pfalz, made with Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier. Crafted using the traditional method and aged on lees, it has fine bubbles and flavors of green apple, citrus, and dark berries, with a crisp finish. It pairs well with many dishes, reflecting Lukas Krauß’s authentic winemaking style.

Grapes: Pinot Noir & Pinot Meunier

Alcoholpercentage: 12,5%

Profile: Green apple, citrus zest, and subtle brioche notes.

products.title: Babatise 2024
products.body_html:
A unique and innovative white wine from Clos Bateau, born out of creative necessity after the loss of part of the Sauvage. Babatise combines biodynamically grown Sylvaner, Riesling, and a touch of Gewürztraminer from Alsace, sourced from schist-rich soils. With a peachy hue and a velvety texture imparted by aging on the lees of Mayga (Gamay), this wine defies convention while delivering a fresh and intriguing experience.

Grapes: Sylvaner, Riesling, Gewürztraminer

Flavor Profile:
Fresh and velvety, with unique depth and complexity from aging on Gamay lees.

Vinification:
Direct press, aged in fiber tanks, followed by 3 months of aging on Mayga (Gamay) lees in used barrels, enhancing depth and texture.

Producer:
Clos Bateau, based in Lantignié, Beaujolais, is renowned for its innovative approach to natural winemaking. Sylvie and Thierry’s creative solutions and commitment to biodynamic practices shine through in Babatise, a testament to their passion and adaptability.

products.title: Poelignié - Monthieux VDF Blanc 2024
products.body_html:
100% Chardonnay

Very limited production: 520 bottles made
Terroir: Granite rose, quartz et argile

Direct press and aged for more than 11 months on a Burgundy barrel from 2017.

products.title: Croix Pen(n)et 2024
products.body_html:
A distinctive and terroir-driven red wine from Clos Bateau, crafted from their Croix Pennet parcel, a unique vineyard that straddles the border of Regnié and Lantignié. The south-facing plot, rich in large granite rocks, imparts a unique and inimitable character to this wine. With longer macerations and partial aging in Burgundy barrels, this wine offers depth and complexity while showcasing its remarkable terroir.

Grapes: 100% Gamay Noir

Flavor Profile:
A complex and distinctive expression of Gamay Noir, reflecting the granite-rich terroir and benefiting from a balanced structure imparted by the barrel aging.

Vinification:
Longer macerations for enhanced depth and structure, with 70% of the wine aged in Burgundy barrels to add finesse and complexity.

Producer:
Clos Bateau, located in Lantignié, Beaujolais, is renowned for its natural winemaking philosophy and respect for the land. Sylvie and Thierry’s dedication to crafting terroir-specific wines like Croix Pennet highlights their commitment to expressing the unique character of each vineyard.

products.title: Mayga Beaujolais Lantignié 2024
products.body_html:
A classic yet rustic Gamay from the high-altitude vineyards of Lantignié (418m), rooted in granite soils. Mayga is crafted with Clos Bateau's signature touch, offering versatility—perfect for cozy winter evenings by the fireplace or slightly chilled for summer enjoyment.

Grapes: 100% Gamay

Flavor Profile:
Rustic and classic with a balanced structure, reflecting the granite soil's influence.

Vinification:
Macerated for almost 2 weeks in concrete tanks, followed by aging in used barrels, adding depth and complexity.

Production:
Limited to just 2,150 bottles, showcasing the meticulous care and craftsmanship behind each bottle.

Producer:
Clos Bateau, located in Lantignié, Beaujolais, is a biodiverse haven led by Sylvie and Thierry. Their natural winemaking philosophy and respect for the land shine through in their distinctive "Vins Vivants," crafted from their low-yield, high-quality vines.

products.title: Nuits Noires 2024
products.body_html:
A special cuvée crafted by Clos Bateau, Nuits Noires is an exploration of depth and complexity. Derived from the same grapes as their baby Joujou, this wine takes a unique path with open-top fermentation and partial aging in used Burgundy barrels. The result is a red wine with distinct character and a nuanced touch.

Grapes: 100% Gamay Noir

Flavor Profile:
Rich and layered, showcasing a deeper and more complex expression of Clos Bateau’s winemaking.

Vinification:
Open-top fermentation for enhanced structure and aging in used Burgundy barrels, adding depth and subtle oak nuances.

Producer:
Clos Bateau, a biodiverse domaine in Lantignié, Beaujolais, is led by Sylvie and Thierry, who craft natural wines with minimal intervention. Their innovative approach and dedication to the land create distinctive and expressive "Vins Vivants."

products.title: Ousia VDF Rosé 2024
products.body_html:
A creative and refreshing rosé crafted by Clos Bateau, blending direct-pressed Gamay and Chardonnay with whole-bunch Chardonnay for a touch of structure and complexity. This wine captures the essence of freshness and fruitiness while adding a textured layer from the subtle maceration.

Grapes: Gamay, Chardonnay

Flavor Profile:
Fresh and fruity with balanced structure and a lively character.

Vinification:
Direct press of Gamay and Chardonnay with whole-bunch Chardonnay added to the tank for a short maceration, enhancing depth and balance.

Producer:
Clos Bateau, led by Sylvie and Thierry, is dedicated to biodiverse and sustainable practices in their 5.1-hectare vineyard in Lantignié, Beaujolais. Embracing natural winemaking with indigenous yeasts and minimal intervention, they craft expressive and lively "Vins Vivants." Their commitment to fostering biodiversity and respecting the land creates wines that truly reflect their unique terroir and passion for natural viticulture.

products.title: La Désirée 2023
products.body_html:
A textured and age-worthy Chenin Blanc from Renaud Guettier of La Grapperie, La Désirée 2018 is a powerful, contemplative white that reflects the depth and precision of old-vine Chenin grown on limestone-rich soils. Long élevage in old barrels brings out layers of ripe stone fruit, citrus oil, beeswax, and flinty minerality. Structured yet vibrant, this wine balances richness with electric tension, showing both generosity and restraint.

Origin: Loire Valley, France
Grapes: 100% Chenin Blanc
Style: Textural, mineral, and age-worthy white
Year: 2023
Alcohol: 12%
Vinification: Spontaneous fermentation, aged in old barrels, bottled unfined and unfiltered, no added SO₂

La Désirée 2018 is a serious Chenin for lovers of complexity and energy—equally suited for cellaring or pairing with refined dishes like roast poultry, seafood in sauce, or aged cheeses.

products.title: Aphrodite 2022
products.body_html:
A stunning Chenin Blanc crafted from century-old vines, embodying the essence of heritage and craftsmanship. The grapes are gently pressed and fermented in barrels, followed by two years of élevage in ancient tuffeau caves nestled in the hills. This meticulous aging results in a wine of exceptional balance and elegance.

With aromas of baked apple, subtle minerals, and warm spice, it unfolds gracefully on the palate. A persistent, refreshing acidity provides harmony and length, making it a wine of remarkable depth and poise.

Grapes: 100% Chenin Blanc
Aging: 2 years in tuffeau caves
Profile: Baked apple, minerals, spice, with a lingering acidic finish

products.title: Pink B 2023
products.body_html:
The Chenin is directly pressed and ferments spontaneously. Just before bottling, a small amount of Pineau d’Aunis from the Adonis cuvée is added.
A crisp, sparkling rosé with fine, precise bubbles. Notes of fresh red berries ride over a clean mineral line.

products.title: Premières Tries 2023
products.body_html: This new cuvée comes from the first pick of each of Renaud’s parcels of Chenin Blanc and therefore includes vines both young and old. The grapes were pressed directly and moved to old barrels for fifteen months of élevage, and here a cooler vintage has rendered a pale, delicate and nuanced expression of the grape that is incredibly compelling in its youth.

products.title: Sange de Terre 2024
products.body_html:
A truly unique creation from Clos Bateau, Sang de Terre is crafted using Pinot Noir and vinified in Georgian qvevri buried in their garden. With an extended maceration of 10 months, this wine is a labor of love, expressing deep complexity and character. After pressing with a traditional wooden press, the wine rested for 1.5 months in a barrel before bottling, resulting in a bold and expressive cuvée.

Grapes: 100% Pinot Noir

Flavor Profile:
Deeply complex and layered, showcasing the distinctive texture and nuance derived from long maceration and qvevri aging.

Vinification:
10 months of maceration in Georgian qvevri, pressed with a wooden press, and aged for 1.5 months in barrels to refine its profile.

Producer:
Clos Bateau, led by Sylvie and Thierry, continues to innovate with natural winemaking techniques. Their use of qvevri reflects their dedication to blending tradition and creativity, producing wines that are as unique as their biodiverse vineyard in Lantignié, Beaujolais.

products.title: La Diablesse 2020
products.body_html:
This extraordinary white wine, made from Chenin vines aged 50 to 115 years, is rooted in the flint clay and limestone soils of Dissay-sous-Courcillon. Nestled at an altitude of 100 meters, the vineyards are carefully tended to ensure optimal ripeness, with grapes hand-harvested and meticulously sorted. The juice undergoes a completely natural vinification process, with no additives or interventions, preserving the essence of the grape, vintage, and terroir. Fermentation is spontaneous, driven by native yeasts, and gravity is used to handle the wines gently.

Aged for 36 months on lees and under a veil in barrels within ancient tuffeau-stone cellars, this oxidative, dry Chenin unveils a unique and profound complexity. Its layered profile is marked by notes of toasted nuts, bruised apple, dried apricot, and a subtle salinity, underscored by a powerful mineral structure.
